body.name: Finite observed-cell factorial lift
body.construction: For independent \(N_j\sim\operatorname{Pois}(m q_j)\), define \(G_h(N_j;z_j,m)=\sum_{r=0}^h\binom hr(-z_j)^{h-r}(N_j)_r/m^r\). If \(Q_L(q-z)=\sum_{\alpha\in\mathcal A_{2K,L}}\gamma_\alpha(q-z)^\alpha\), set \(U_{Q_L}=\sum_{\alpha\in\mathcal A_{2K,L}}\gamma_\alpha\prod_{j=1}^{2K}G_{\alpha_j}(N_j;z_j,m)\). Given the coefficient table, recursively computing the falling factorials and evaluating the dense sum uses at most \(C_2\{K L^2+L M_{2K,L}\}\) arithmetic operations and \(C_2\{K L+M_{2K,L}\}\) stored scalars.
